column1: # Item Master Upload Template - WMS Philippines
# Item Master Template for Product Information
# - Pallet_Qty: Number of units that fit on one pallet
# - Stackable: TRUE/FALSE - can pallets be stacked
# - Max_Stack_Height: Maximum number of pallets that can be stacked
# - Stock Levels: Min/Max/Reorder point for inventory management
# - Batch_Tracking: TRUE/FALSE - requires batch number tracking
# - Serial_Tracking: TRUE/FALSE - requires serial number tracking
# - Shelf_Life_Days: Number of days product remains usable
# - Consider tropical climate for shelf life
# - DOH/FDA requirements for food items expiry tracking
